environment.description: Same CI/CD dashboard plugin deployed in a namespace with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'baseline' level via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline). The pod spec uses securityContext with runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and drops ALL capabilities. A Cilium NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the CI backend API on port 443. The container image is distroless (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian11). Node-level admission controller validates that no hostPath volumes are mounted. The service is fronted by an Envoy sidecar injected via Istio with AuthorizationPolicy requiring valid JWT from the internal OIDC provider, and the Envoy filter chain includes a Lua filter that strips any response body containing patterns matching '<script', 'javascript:', 'onerror=', 'onload=' before returning to the client, effectively acting as an output-sanitizing reverse proxy layer.
